reports.title: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Based on current trends and expectations, we currently expect fiscal year 2026 revenue to be approximately $3.07 billion and diluted adjusted earnings per common share to be in the range of $4.98 to $5.03. The Company will provide additional information on its outlook during its earnings conference call.
